Load libraries
```{r}
library(sensobol)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
source("src/environment_set.R") #Load functions and packages from CellTFusion
```

Define parameter ranges
```{r}
# Number of samples per parameter
N <- 1000  

# Define the number of parameters
k <- 3

# Generate Sobol sample matrix
X <- sobol_matrices(N = N, params = c("X1", "X2", "X3"), order = "third")

# Fix parameter ranges
param_info <- list(
  X1 = c(-1, 1),    # Uniform [-1,1]
  X2 = c(0, 2),     # Uniform [0,2]
  X3 = c(-3,2)     # Uniform [-3,2]
)

# Rescale only the uniformly sampled parameters
for (i in seq_along(param_info)) {
  param_name <- names(param_info)[i]
  
  min_val <- param_info[[param_name]][1]
  max_val <- param_info[[param_name]][2]
    
  # Apply min-max transformation
  X[, i] <- min_val + X[, i] * (max_val - min_val)
}

head(X)  # Show first few rows
```

Define model function
```{r}
# Define the model function
model_function <- function(X) {
  x1 <- X[, 1]
  x2 <- X[, 2]
  x3 <- X[, 3]
  return(x1^2 + x2 + sin(x3))
}

# Compute model outputs for Sobol samples
y <- model_function(X)
```

Compute Sobol Sensitivity Indices
```{r}
# Compute Sobol indices using the Jansen estimator
sobol_results <- sobol_indices(Y = y, N = N, params = colnames(X), type = "jansen")

# Print sensitivity indices
print(sobol_results)
```

Plot sensitivity indices
```{r}
# Plot first-order and total-order Sobol indices
ggplot(sobol_results$results, aes(x = parameters, y = original, fill = sensitivity)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Sobol Sensitivity Analysis",
       x = "Parameters",
       y = "Sobol Index") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"))
```
